Assessment.content: Acute asthma exacerbation likely viral-induced with wheeze, chest tightness, and exertional dyspnea in a patient with history of asthma and recent lapse in inhaler use
Assessment.source_text: 1) Acute asthma exacerbation likely viral-induced, with wheeze, chest tightness, and exertional dyspnea in a patient with history of asthma and recent lapse in controller/controller-inhaler use.

Assessment.content: History of significant asthma severity with adolescent hospitalization requiring intubation and currently not on maintenance therapy, posing risk of recurrence without proper inhaled therapy
Assessment.source_text: 2) Past asthma severity significant (adolescent hospitalization with intubation) but currently not on maintenance therapy; risk of recurrence without proper inhaled therapy.

Assessment.content: Coexisting viral upper respiratory infection symptoms including sore throat and runny nose with persistent cough
Assessment.source_text: 3) Coexisting viral URI symptoms (sore throat, runny nose) with persistent cough.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribe Ventolin (Salbutamol) and Clenil Modulite inhalers to be delivered within about one hour and provide a spacer
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Prescriptions for Ventolin (Salbutamol) and Clenil Modulite inhalers to be delivered within ~1 hour; provide spacer.

Plan_of_Care.content: Instruct patient to use spacer by priming with puffs then taking 5–10 inhaled breaths per puff
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Use spacer: prime with puffs, then inhaled breaths (5–10 breaths per puff).

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise as needed use of Ventolin and to seek medical attention if rescue is needed more than every 3 hours
Plan_of_Care.source_text: PRN use of Ventolin; escalate if needing rescue more than every 3 hours → seek medical attention.

Plan_of_Care.content: Start a short course of oral steroids for 5 days at 2 tablets each morning
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Systemic corticosteroids: Short course oral steroids for 5 days; 2 tablets each morning (as discussed).

Plan_of_Care.content: After improvement, continue Clenil Modulite daily in the morning with PRN Ventolin using spacer as instructed
Plan_of_Care.source_text: After improvement, continue Clenil Modulite daily in the morning with PRN Ventolin; spacer as above.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise patient to seek medical attention for worsening shortness of breath, chest pain, dizziness, or inability to maintain breathing
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advise to seek medical attention for worsening SOB, chest pain, dizziness, or if unable to maintain breathing.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise patient to self-certify off work for 7 days and rest as needed until better
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Work note: Self-certify for 7 days; rest as needed until better.

Plan_of_Care.content: Review potential steroid side effects including mood changes, hyperglycemia, rash, and nausea
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Education: Review potential steroid side effects (mood changes, hyperglycemia, rash, nausea) per label.

Follow_up_Information.content: Re-evaluate if symptoms persist or worsen after starting therapy and return for further management if needed
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Follow-up: Re-evaluate if symptoms persist or worsen after starting therapy; return for further management if needed.
